meta.title: Schools & Education System
meta.relevance_note: Why school data matters to a QSR net-lease asset: (1) school quality and school-boundary density drive resident retention and therefore daytime population and family dayparts; (2) LAUSD enrolment is the best available official proxy for the number of households with children inside the city; (3) district finances affect local bond levies, which appear as direct charges on the parcel's property tax bill under a NNN lease where the tenant reimburses taxes.
